#{order.status}\",\n        \":CREATED_AT: #{order.created_at}\",\n        \":UPDATED_AT: #{order.updated_at}\",\n        \":END:\",\n        \"\",\n        \"** Summary\",\n        presence(order.description) || order.title,\n        \"\",\n        \"** Labels\",\n        labels,\n        \"\",\n        \"** Task Breakdown\",\n        \"*** Discovery\",\n        \"- Clarify constraints.\",\n        \"- Collect existing context and artifacts.\",\n        \"\",\n        \"*** Implementation\",\n        \"- Prepare patch or commit sequence.\",\n        \"- Keep issue-specific notes in this directory.\",\n        \"\",\n        \"*** Verification\",\n        \"- Record manual and automated validation steps.\",\n      ].join('\\n')\n    end\n\n    private def self.lefine_org_content(order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord, repository : RepositoryRecord) : String\n      [\n        \"* #{order.title}\",\n        \":PROPERTIES:\",\n        \":UUID: #{repository.server_uuid}\",\n        \":ORDER_ID: #{order.id}\",\n        \":PROJECT_ID: #{repository.project_id}\",\n        \":REPOSITORY_ID: #{repository.id}\",\n        \":VISIBILITY: #{repository.visibility}\",\n        \":PUBLIC_CLONE_URL: #{presence(repository.public_clone_url) || \"-\"}\",\n        \":SSH_CLONE_URL: #{presence(repository.ssh_clone_url) || \"-\"}\",\n        \":END:\",\n        \"\",\n        \"** Context\",\n        presence(order.description) || order.title,\n        \"\",\n        \"** Product Description\",\n        presence(order.description) || \"-\",\n      ].join('\\n')\n    end\n\n    private def self.order_document_content(order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord) : String?\n      raw = order.document_json\n      return nil unless raw\n\n      object = JSON.parse(raw).as_h?\n      presence(object.try(&.[\"content\"]?).try(&.as_s?))\n    rescue\n      nil\n    end\n\n    private def self.plan_org_content(order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord, repository : RepositoryRecord) : String\n      existing = order_document_content(order)\n      return existing if existing && existing.match(/^\\*+\\s+/m)\n\n      body = existing || presence(order.description) || order.title\n      [\n        \"* #{order.title}\",\n        \":PROPERTIES:\",\n        \":ID: #{order.id}-plan\",\n        \":ORDER_ID: #{order.id}\",\n        \":PROJECT_ID: #{repository.project_id}\",\n        \":REPOSITORY_ID: #{repository.id}\",\n        \":STATE: active\",\n        \":END:\",\n        \"\",\n        body,\n      ].join('\\n')\n    end\n\n    private def self.deserialize_attachments(value : String?) : Array(JSON::Any)\n      return [] of JSON::Any if value.nil? || value.empty?\n\n      JSON.parse(value).as_a\n    rescue\n      [] of JSON::Any\n    end\n\n    private def self.issue_artifact?(attachment : JSON::Any) : Bool\n      object = attachment.as_h?\n      return false unless object\n\n      name = presence(object[\"name\"]?.try(&.as_s?)) || \"\"\n      media_type = presence(object[\"mediaType\"]?.try(&.as_s?)) || \"\"\n      extension = File.extname(name).downcase\n\n      ISSUE_ARTIFACT_EXTENSIONS.includes?(extension) || ISSUE_ARTIFACT_MEDIA_TYPES.includes?(media_type.downcase)\n    end\n\n    private def self.issue_artifact_content(attachment : JSON::Any) : String?\n      object = attachment.as_h?\n      return nil unless object\n\n      content = object[\"content\"]?.try(&.as_s?)\n      presence(content)\n    end\n\n    private def self.issue_artifact_filename(attachment : JSON::Any, index : Int32) : String\n      object = attachment.as_h?\n      raw = object.try { |candidate| presence(candidate[\"name\"]?.try(&.as_s?)) } || \"artifact-#{index + 1}\"\n      sanitized = raw.gsub(/[^\\w.\\-]+/, \"-\").gsub(/^-+|-+$/, \"\")\n      sanitized.empty? ? \"artifact-#{index + 1}\" : sanitized\n    end\n\n    private def self.resolve_lepos_config(worktree_path : String) : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings\n      config_path = File.join(worktree_path, \".lepos.rcl\")\n      settings = LeposConfig.load(config_path)\n      unless File.exists?(config_path)\n        File.write(config_path, settings.render_default_file)\n      end\n      settings\n    end\n\n    private def self.resolve_lepos_config(record : RepositoryRecord) : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings\n      content = run_git_output([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"show\", \"HEAD:.lepos.rcl\"])\n      LeposConfig.parse(content)\n    rescue\n      LeposConfig::RepositorySettings.default\n    end\n\n    private def self.resolve_reps_config(\n      record : RepositoryRecord,\n      lepos_settings : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings\n    ) : LeposConfig::RepsSettings\n      lepos_settings.reps_sources.each do |path|\n        normalized_path = path.strip\n        next if normalized_path.empty?\n\n        content = run_git_output([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"show\", \"HEAD:#{normalized_path}\"])\n        parsed = LeposConfig.parse_reps(content)\n        return LeposConfig::RepsSettings.new(\n          repositories: parsed.repositories,\n          repository_config_path: normalized_path,\n          agent_system_prompt_path: parsed.agent_system_prompt_path\n        )\n      rescue\n      end\n\n      LeposConfig::RepsSettings.default\n    end\n\n    private def self.write_repository_gitignore(worktree_path : String, main_readme : String) : Nil\n      gitignore_path = File.join(worktree_path, \".gitignore\")\n      entry = main_readme\n      normalized_entry = entry.strip\n\n      return if normalized_entry.empty?\n      return if normalized_entry.starts_with?(\"#\")\n      return if normalized_entry == PLAN_DOCUMENT_PATH\n\n      if File.exists?(gitignore_path)\n        existing = File.read(gitignore_path).split('\\n').map(&.strip).reject(&.empty?)\n        return if existing.includes?(normalized_entry)\n        File.write(gitignore_path, existing.join('\\n') + \"\\n#{normalized_entry}\\n\")\n      else\n        File.write(gitignore_path, \"#{normalized_entry}\\n\")\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.ensure_issue_artifacts_table(config : Utils::Config) : Nil\n      setup(config)\n    end\n\n    private def self.persist_issue_artifact(\n      repository : RepositoryRecord,\n      order_id : String,\n      artifact_key : String,\n      content : String,\n      config : Utils::Config\n    ) : Nil\n      ensure_issue_artifacts_table(config)\n      now = current_time\n      database(config).exec(\n        <<-SQL,\n          INSERT INTO repository_issue_artifacts (repository_id, order_id, artifact_key, content, created_at, updated_at)\n          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)\n          ON CONFLICT (repository_id, order_id, artifact_key) DO UPDATE SET\n            content = EXCLUDED.content,\n            updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at\n        SQL\n        repository.id,\n        order_id,\n        artifact_key,\n        content,\n        now,\n        now\n      )\n    end\n\n    private def self.write_issue_artifacts_to_database(\n      repository : RepositoryRecord,\n      order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord,\n      settings : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings,\n      config : Utils::Config\n    ) : Nil\n      ensure_issue_artifacts_table(config)\n\n      persist_issue_artifact(repository, order.id, settings.issue_readme_path(order.id), meta_issue_readme_content(settings), config)\n      persist_issue_artifact(repository, order.id, settings.issue_file_path(order.id), issue_org_content(order, repository), config)\n      deserialize_attachments(order.attachment_json).each_with_index do |attachment, index|\n        next unless issue_artifact?(attachment)\n\n        content = issue_artifact_content(attachment)\n        next unless content\n        key = settings.issue_attachment_path(order.id, issue_artifact_filename(attachment, index))\n        persist_issue_artifact(repository, order.id, key, content, config)\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.write_issue_artifacts_to_files(\n      worktree_path : String,\n      order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord,\n      repository : RepositoryRecord,\n      settings : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings\n    ) : Nil\n      issue_root = File.join(worktree_path, settings.issue_root_path)\n      issue_dir = File.join(issue_root, order.id)\n      issue_attachments_dir = File.join(issue_dir, settings.issue_attachments_dir)\n\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(issue_attachments_dir)\n      File.write(File.join(issue_root, settings.issue_readme_name), meta_issue_readme_content(settings))\n      File.write(File.join(issue_dir, settings.issue_file_name), issue_org_content(order, repository))\n      deserialize_attachments(order.attachment_json).each_with_index do |attachment, index|\n        next unless issue_artifact?(attachment)\n\n        content = issue_artifact_content(attachment)\n        next unless content\n\n        File.write(File.join(issue_attachments_dir, issue_artifact_filename(attachment, index)), content)\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.write_seed_files(\n      worktree_path : String,\n      order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord,\n      repository : RepositoryRecord,\n      config : Utils::Config\n    ) : Nil\n      settings = resolve_lepos_config(worktree_path)\n      main_readme_path = settings.repository_readme_path\n      plan_path = settings.plan_path\n      main_readme_full_path = File.join(worktree_path, main_readme_path)\n      plan_full_path = File.join(worktree_path, plan_path)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(main_readme_full_path))\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(plan_full_path))\n\n      File.write(main_readme_full_path, lefine_org_content(order, repository))\n      File.write(plan_full_path, plan_org_content(order, repository))\n      write_repository_gitignore(worktree_path, main_readme_path)\n\n      if settings.filesystem_storage?\n        write_issue_artifacts_to_files(worktree_path, order, repository, settings)\n      else\n        write_issue_artifacts_to_database(repository, order, settings, config)\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.plan_document_paths(record : RepositoryRecord) : Array(String)\n      configured = begin\n        resolve_lepos_config(record).plan_path\n      rescue\n        PLAN_DOCUMENT_PATH\n      end\n\n      [configured, PLAN_DOCUMENT_PATH, LEGACY_PLAN_DOCUMENT_PATH].compact_map do |path|\n        normalized = LeposConfig::RepositorySettings.sanitize_path(path)\n        normalized.empty? ? nil : normalized\n      end.uniq\n    end\n\n    def self.read_plan_document(record : RepositoryRecord, config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : String?\n      plan_document_paths(record).each do |path|\n        begin\n          content = run_git_output([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"show\", \"HEAD:#{path}\"])\n          return content unless content.empty?\n        rescue\n        end\n      end\n\n      nil\n    end\n\n    def self.commit_plan_document(\n      record : RepositoryRecord,\n      actor_handle : String,\n      content : String,\n      config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load\n    ) : Nil\n      temp_path = File.join(worktrees_root, \"plan-#{record.id}-#{UUID.random}\")\n      FileUtils.rm_rf(temp_path)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(temp_path)\n\n      begin\n        begin\n          run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"checkout\", \"-f\", record.default_branch])\n        rescue\n        end\n\n        settings = resolve_lepos_config(temp_path)\n        plan_path = settings.plan_path\n        plan_path = PLAN_DOCUMENT_PATH if plan_path.empty?\n        full_path = File.join(temp_path, plan_path)\n        FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(full_path))\n        File.write(full_path, content)\n\n        run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"config\", \"user.name\", \"Lefine\"])\n        run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"config\", \"user.email\", \"git@#{config.domain}\"])\n        run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"add\", \".lepos.rcl\", plan_path])\n        status = run_git_output([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"status\", \"--porcelain\"])\n        return if status.strip.empty?\n\n        author = normalize_handle(actor_handle)\n        run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"--work-tree\", temp_path, \"commit\", \"-m\", \"Update PLAN.org\", \"--author\", \"#{author} <git@#{config.domain}>\"])\n        run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"update-server-info\"])\n      ensure\n        FileUtils.rm_rf(temp_path)\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.seed_repository(record : RepositoryRecord, order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord, config : Utils::Config) : Nil\n      return if File.exists?(File.join(record.repo_path, \"HEAD\"))\n\n      worktree_path = \"\"\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(repositories_root)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(worktrees_root)\n      FileUtils.rm_rf(record.repo_path)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(record.repo_path))\n\n      worktree_path = File.join(worktrees_root, record.id)\n      FileUtils.rm_rf(worktree_path)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(worktree_path)\n\n      run_git!([\"init\", \"--bare\", \"--initial-branch=#{record.default_branch}\", record.repo_path])\n      run_git!([\"init\", \"--initial-branch=#{record.default_branch}\"], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"config\", \"user.name\", \"Lefine\"], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"config\", \"user.email\", \"git@#{config.domain}\"], chdir: worktree_path)\n\n      write_seed_files(worktree_path, order, record, config)\n\n      run_git!([\"add\", \".\"], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"commit\", \"-m\", \"Initial task repository\"], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"remote\", \"add\", \"origin\", record.repo_path], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"push\", \"origin\", record.default_branch], chdir: worktree_path)\n      run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"update-server-info\"])\n      install_receive_hooks(record)\n    ensure\n      if path = worktree_path\n        FileUtils.rm_rf(path) unless path.empty?\n      end\n    end\n\n    private def self.persist(record : RepositoryRecord, config : Utils::Config) : Nil\n      setup(config)\n      database(config).exec(\n        <<-SQL,\n          INSERT INTO       name = EXCLUDED.name,\n            visibility = EXCLUDED.visibility,\n            default_branch = EXCLUDED.default_branch,\n            server_uuid = EXCLUDED.server_uuid,\n            public_clone_url = EXCLUDED.public_clone_url,\n            ssh_clone_url = EXCLUDED.ssh_clone_url,\n            repo_path = EXCLUDED.repo_path,\n            updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at\n        SQL\n        record.id,\n        record.project_id,\n        record.order_id,\n        record.slug,\n        record.name,\n        record.visibility,\n        record.default_branch,\n Utils::Config.load) : Bool\n      return true if record.visibility == \"public\"\n\n      owner = owner_handle_for(record, config)\n      settings = git_settings(record, config)\n      actor = normalize_handle(actor_handle)\n      groups = [\"authenticated\"] of String\n      groups << \"admin\" if actor == owner\n      groups << \"exchange\" if actor == normalize_handle(settings.exchange_actor)\n      groups << \"agents\" if fetch_agent_handles(config).includes?(actor)\n\n      rule = settings.acl_rules.find { |candidate| glob_match?(candidate.branch_pattern, branch_name) }\n      return false unless rule\n\n      !(rule.allowed_groups & groups).empty?\n    end\n\n    def self.resolve_exchange_run(record : config).exchange_run_default\n    end\n\n    def self.agent_handles(config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : Array(String)\n      fetch_agent_handles(config)\n    end\n\n    def self.prepare_git_transport(record : RepositoryRecord) : Nil\n      install_receive_hooks(record)\n    end\n\n    def self.find_by_owner_and_project_clone_name(owner_handle : String, clone_name :    list(config).find do |repository|\n        owner_handle_for(repository, config) == normalized_owner &&\n          (\n            repository.project_id == normalized_clone_name ||\n              repository.order_id == normalized_clone_name ||\n              repository.slug == normalized_clone_name\n          )\n      end\n    end\n\n    def self.ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name(owner_handle : String, clone_name : String, config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load, visibility : String = \"private\") : RepositoryRecord\n      normalized_owner = normalize_handle(owner_handle)\n      normalized_clone_name = normalize_clone_name(clone_name)\n      normalized_visibility = visibility == \"public\" ? \"public\" : \"private\"\n      existing = find_by_owner_and_project_clone_name(normalized_owner, normalized_clone_name, config)\n      if existing\n        install_receive_hooks(existing)\n        return existing\n      end\n\n      now = current_time\n      tail = normalized_clone_name.split('/').last\n      slug_source = normalized_clone_name.gsub(\"/\", \"-\")\n      slug = unique_slug(slug_source, \"#{normalized_owner}-#{slug_source}\", config)\n      record = RepositoryRecord.new(\n        id: UUID.random.to_s,\n        project_id: normalized_clone_name,\n        order_id: ad_hoc_order_id(normalized_owner, normalized_clone_name),\n        slug: slug,\n        name: tail,\n        visibility: normalized_visibility,\n        default_branch: DEFAULT_BRANCH,\n        server_uuid: UUID.random.to_s,\n        public_clone_url: public_clone_url(slug, normalized_visibility, config),\n        ssh_clone_url: : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : String\n      owner_handle_for(record, config)\n    end\n\n    def self.list(config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : Array(RepositoryRecord)\n      setup(config)\n      database(config).query_all(\n        \"SELECT id, project_id, order_id, slug, name, visibility, default_branch, server_uuid, public_clone_url, ssh_clone_url, repo_path, created_at, updated_at FROM repositories ORDER BY created_at DESC\",\n        as: {String, String, String, String, String, String, String, String, String?, String?, String, String, String}\n      ).map do |row|\n        hydrate_record(row)\n      end\n    end\n\n    def self.ensure_for_order(order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord, config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : RepositoryRecord\n      existing = find_by_order(order.id, config)\n      if existing\n        visibility = resolve_visibility(order)\n        changed = false\n        if existing.project_id != order.id\n          existing.project_id = order.id\n          changed = true\n        end\n        if existing.name != order.title\n          existing.name = order.title\n          changed = true\n        end\n        if existing.visibility != visibility\n          existing.visibility = visibility\n          existing.public_clone_url = public_clone_url(existing.slug, visibility, config)\n          changed = true\n        end\n        if changed\n          existing.updated_at = current_time\n          persist(existing, config)\n        end\n        install_receive_hooks(existing)\n        seed_repository(existing, order, config)\n        return existing\n      end\n\n      now = current_time\n      visibility = resolve_visibility(order)\n      slug = unique_slug(slugify(order.title), order.id, config)\n      record = RepositoryRecord.new(\n        id: UUID.random.to_s,\n        project_id: order.id,\n        order_id: order.id,\n        slug: slug,\n        name: order.title,\n        visibility: visibility,\n        default_branch: DEFAULT_BRANCH,\n        server_uuid: UUID.random.to_s,\n        public_clone_url: public_clone_url(slug, visibility, config),\n        ssh_clone_url: OrderQueue::OrderRecord) : String\n      return \"public\" if order.is_public_task\n      return \"public\" if order.labels.any? { |label| normalized = label.strip.downcase; normalized == \"public\" || normalized == \"repo-public\" }\n\n      \"private\"\n    end\n\n    private def self.owner_handle_for_order(order : OrderQueue::OrderRecord, config : Utils::Config) : String\n      normalize_handle(order.owner_username || order.actor_handle || config.actor_username)\n    end\n\n    private def self.owner_handle_from_actor_uri(value : String?) : String?\n      actor_uri = normalize_handle(candidate) }\n    end\n\n    private def self.owner_handle_from_activity(activity : JSON::Any) : String?\n      queue = [activity]\n      actor_handle_fallback : String? = nil\n\n      until queue.empty?\n        current = queue.shift\n        current_hash = current.as_h?\n        next unless current_hash\n\n        handle = presence(current_hash[\"ownerUsername\"]?.try(&.as_s?)) || presence(current_hash[\"actorHandle\"]?.try(&.as_s?))\n        return normalize_handle(handle) if handle\n\n        actor_handle_fallback ||= owner_handle_from_actor_uri(current_hash[\"actor\"]?.try(&.as_s?))\n        actor_handle_fallback ||= owner_handle_from_actor_uri(current_hash[\"attributedTo\"]?.try(&.as_s?))\n\n        %w[object offeredItem ticket target].each do |key|\n          nested = current_hash[key]?\n          queue << nested if nested\n        end\n      end\n\n      actor_handle_fallback\n    end\n\n    private def self.owner_handle_from_activities(order_id : String, config : Utils::Config) : String?\n      OrderQueue.activities_for_order(order_id, config, 5).each do |activity|\n        handle = owner_handle_from_activity(activity)\n        return handle if handle\n      end\n\n      nil\n    end\n\n    private def self.owner_handle_for(record : RepositoryRecord, config : Utils::Config) : normalize_handle(config.actor_username)\n      end\n\n      order_handle = presence(order.owner_username) || presence(order.actor_handle)\n      return normalize_handle(order_handle) if order_handle\n\n      owner_handle_from_activities(record.order_id, config) || normalize_handle(config.actor_username)\n    end\n\n    private def self.ad_hoc_order_id(owner_handle : String,     presence(owner)\n    end\n\n    private def self.normalize_clone_name(value : String) : String\n      segments = value.split('/').map { |segment| slugify(segment) }.reject(&.empty?)\n      raise groups = rule.allowed_groups.compact_map { |group| normalize_group(group) }.uniq\n        next nil if groups.empty?\n        rule_id = presence(rule.id) || UUID.random.to_s\n\n        GitAclRule.new(\n          id: rule_id,\n          branch_pattern: branch_pattern,\n          allowed_groups: groups\n        )\n      end\n\n      rules = defaults.acl_rules if rules.empty?\n\n      GitSettings.new(\n        exchange_run_default: value.exchange_run_default,\n        exchange_actor: exchange_actor_handle(config),\n        agent_source_url: agent_source_url(config),\n = nil) : Nil\n      output = IO::Memory.new\n      error = IO::Memory.new\n      status = if chdir\n                 Process.run(\"git\", args, chdir: chdir, output: output, error: error)\n               else\n                 Process.run(\"git\", args, output: output, error: error)\n               end\n      return if status.success?\n\n      raise \"git #{args.join(' ')} failed: #{presence(error.to_s.strip) || presence(output.to_s.strip) || status.exit_code}\"\n    end\n\n    private def self.run_git_output(args : Array(String), chdir : String? = nil) : String\n      output = IO::Memory.new\n      error = IO::Memory.new\n      status = if chdir\n                 Process.run(\"git\", args, chdir: chdir, output: output, error: error)\n               else\n                 Process.run(\"git\", args, output: output, error: error)\n               end\n      return output.to_s if status.success?\n\n      raise \"git #{args.join(' ')} failed: #{presence(error.to_s.strip) || presence(output.to_s.strip) || status.exit_code}\"\n    end\n\n    private def self.glob_match?(pattern : String, value : String) : Bool\n      regex = Regex.new(\"\\\\A\" +  ]\n\n      urls.each do |url|\n        begin\n          response = HTTP::Client.get(url, headers: HTTP::Headers{\"Accept\" => \"application/json\"}, tls: url.starts_with?(\"https://\"))\n          next unless response.status_code == 200\n\n          items = JSON.parse(response.body).as_h?.try { |doc| doc[\"orderedItems\"]? || doc[\"items\"]? || doc[\"followers\"]? } || next\n          values = items.as_a?.try do |array|\n            array.compact_map do |item|\n              if raw = item.as_s?\n                normalize_handle(raw.split('/').last? || raw.split('@').reject(&.empty?).last? || raw)\n              elsif object = item.as_h?\n                normalize_handle(object[\"preferredUsername\"]?.try(&.as_s?) || object[\"handle\"]?.try(&.as_s?) || object[\"id\"]?.try(&.as_s?))\n end\n      end\n\n      [] of String\n    end\n\n    private def self.init_empty_bare_repository(record : RepositoryRecord) : Nil\n      FileUtils.rm_rf(record.repo_path)\n record.repo_path, \"update-server-info\"])\n      install_receive_hooks(record)\n    end\n\n    # Clones a remote repository as a bare mirror, replacing the contents\n    # of the existing bare repository at record.repo_path.\n    #\n    # This method only touches the filesystem — it does not update the\n    # RepositoryRecord. Call ForgeFedStore.sync_repository afterwards to\n    # sync the discovered branch state into the database.\n    def self.git_clone_mirror!(record : RepositoryRecord, remote_url : String) : Nil\n      FileUtils.rm_rf(record.repo_path)\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(record.repo_path))\n      run_git!([\"clone\", \"--bare\", \"--mirror\", remote_url, record.repo_path])\n      run_git!([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"update-server-info\"])\n      install_receive_hooks(record)\n    end\n\n    # Detects the mirror's HEAD branch and adopts it as the record's\n    # default_branch, persisting the change when it differs from the current\n    # value. Imported repositories frequently use a trunk other than \"main\"\n    # (e.g. \"master\"), and ForgeFed sync must treat the real trunk as the\n    # default so it does not open a spurious merge request for it.\n    #\n    # Returns the resolved default branch name. The record is left untouched\n    # (and no DB write happens) when HEAD cannot be resolved — for example an\n    # empty repository with no commits.\n    def self.adopt_mirror_default_branch!(record : RepositoryRecord, config : Utils::Config = Utils::Config.load) : String\n      detected = begin\n        presence(run_git_output([\"--git-dir\", record.repo_path, \"symbolic-ref\", \"--short\", \"HEAD\"]).strip)\n      rescue\n        nil\n      end\n\n      if detected && detected != record.default_branch\n        record.default_branch = detected\n        record.updated_at = current_time\n        persist(record, config)\n      end\n\n      record.default_branch\n    end\n\n    private def self.meta_issue_readme_content(config : LeposConfig::RepositorySettings) : String\n      [\n ensure_issue_artifacts_table(config)\n      now = current_time\n      database(config).exec(\n        <<-SQL,\n          INSERT INTO repository_issue_artifacts (repository_id, order_id, artifact_key, # Repositories are persisted with a slugified project_id (see\n      # ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name → normalize_clone_name), so a\n      # lookup with the original casing/spelling (e.g. repository.order_id == candidate ||\n              repository.slug == candidate\n          end\n      end\n    end\n\n    def self.ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name(owner_handle : String, importing a GitHub repository into the local `crater` (lepos) storage, followed by initializing ForgeFed resources (branches, PatchTracker, MergeRequests, PushEvents). After import the repository must be accessible via:\\n- Git HTTP (`/:owner/:slug.git`, `/git/:slug.git`)\\n- ForgeFed endpoints (`/repositories/:slug`, `/branches/:id`, `/merge-requests/:id`, etc.)\\n- REST API (`/projects/:id`)\\n\\n**Input:**\\n```\\nPOST /import/github\\n{ \\\"owner\\\": \\\"lefinepro\\\", \\\"repo\\\": \\\"crater-github\\\", \\\"visibility\\\": \\\"public\\\" }\\n```\\n\\n**Output:**\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n  \\\"repository\\\": \\\"/repositories/{slug}\\\",\\n  \\\"forgeFedActor\\\": \\\"/repositories/{slug}\\\",\\n  \\\"cloneUrl\\\": \\\"/@lefinepro/crater-github.git\\\"\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Implementation Plan\\n\\n### 1. New handler `POST /import/github`\\n\\n**File:** `src/crater/handlers/github_import.cr` (new)\\n\\n```crystal\\nrequire \\\"kemal\\\"\\nrequire \\\"json\\\"\\nrequire \\\"../repository_store\\\"\\nrequire \\\"../forgefed_store\\\"\\nrequire \\\"../utils/config\\\"\\n\\nmodule Lepos\\n  module Handlers\\n    module GithubImport\\n      def self.register(config : Utils::Config)\\n        post \\\"/import/github\\\" do |env|\\n          handle_import(env, config)\\n        end\\n\\n        get \\\"/import/github/:owner/:repo/status\\\" do |env|\\n          handle_status(env, config)\\n        end\\n      end\\n\\n      # ... implementation\\n    end\\n  end\\nend\\n```\\n\\n**`handle_import` logic:**\\n1. Parse and validate body (`owner`, `repo` required; `visibility` optional, defaults to `\\\"public\\\"`)\\n2. Build remote URL: `\\\"https://github.com/#{owner}/#{repo}.git\\\"`\\n3. Call `RepositoryStore.ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name(owner, repo, config)` — creates DB record and empty bare repo\\n4. Call `RepositoryStore.git_clone_mirror!(record, remote_url)` — replaces bare repo contents with a mirror clone from GitHub\\n5. Call `ForgeFedStore.ensure_repository_resources(record, config)` — creates PatchTracker\\n6. Call `ForgeFedStore.sync_repository(record, config)` — discovers branches, creates MergeRequests, PushEvents, generates activities\\n7. Return JSON result\\n\\n**`handle_status` logic:**\\n1. Lookup via `RepositoryStore.find_by_owner_and_project_clone_name(owner, repo, config)`\\n2. If not found — 404\\n3. Return status: slug, branch count, merge request count, created date\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 2. New method `RepositoryStore.git_clone_mirror!`\\n\\n**File:** `src/crater/repository_store.cr`\\n\\nAdd method (after `init_empty_bare_repository`, ~line 522):\\n\\n```crystal\\n# Clones a remote repository as a bare mirror, replacing the contents\\n# of the existing bare repository at record.repo_path.\\ndef self.git_clone_mirror!(record : RepositoryRecord, remote_url : String) : Nil\\n  FileUtils.rm_rf(record.repo_path)\\n  FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(record.repo_path))\\n  run_git!([\\\"clone\\\", \\\"--bare\\\", \\\"--mirror\\\", remote_url, record.repo_path])\\n  run_git!([\\\"--git-dir\\\", record.repo_path, \\\"update-server-info\\\"])\\n  install_receive_hooks(record)\\nend\\n```\\n\\n**Note:** This method only touches the filesystem — it does not update the `RepositoryRecord`. Call `ForgeFedStore.sync_repository` afterward to sync the branch state into the database.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 3. Wire up the handler in `src/crater.cr`\\n\\n**File:** `src/crater.cr`\\n\\nAdd:\\n\\n```crystal\\n# After other requires (~line 20):\\nrequire \\\"./crater/handlers/github_import\\\"\\n\\n# In Lepos.run, after other register calls (~line 79):\\nHandlers::GithubImport.register(config)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 4. What already exists (no need to implement)\\n\\n- **ForgeFed endpoints** (`/repositories/:slug`, `/branches/:id`, `/merge-requests/:id`, `/patch-trackers/:id`, `/patch-sets/:id`) — fully functional after `sync_repository` + `ensure_repository_resources`\\n- **Git HTTP serving** (`/:owner/:slug/HEAD`, `/:owner/:slug/info/refs`, `/git/:slug/objects/pack/:name`, etc.) — serves objects from `RepositoryRecord.repo_path`\\n- **GitHub OAuth** (`/auth/github/login`, `/auth/github/callback`) — implemented in `oauth_auth.cr`, unrelated to import\\n- **Ad-hoc repositories** (`ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name`) — creates DB record and empty bare repo but does not clone data\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 5. Builds the remote URL `https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}.git`.\\n3. `RepositoryStore.ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name` — creates the DB record + empty bare repo (now honouring `visibility`).\\n4. `RepositoryStore.git_clone_mirror!` — mirror-clones the remote, replacing the bare repo.\\n5. `RepositoryStore.adopt_mirror_default_branch!` — adopts the mirror's real trunk (e.g. `master`) as the default branch.\\n6. `ForgeFedStore.ensure_repository_resources` + `sync_repository` — federates the branches / merge requests.\\n\\nResponse:\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n  \\\"repository\\\": \\\"/repositories/{slug}\\\",\\n  \\\"forgeFedActor\\\": \\\"/repositories/{slug}\\\",\\n  \\\"cloneUrl\\\": \\\"/@{owner}/{repo}.git\\\"\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### `GET /import/github/:owner/:repo/status`\\nReturns `{ ok, slug, ownerHandle, visibility, branchCount, mergeRequestCount, createdAt }`, or a JSON `404` when the repository has not been imported.\\n\\n## Error matrix\\n\\n| Case | Status |\\n|------|--------|\\n| missing body / missing `owner`/`repo` | `400` |\\n| repository already imported | `409` |\\n| clone failed (e.g. repo does not exist) | `502` |\\n| ForgeFed sync failed | `500` |\\n| success | `200` |\\n\\n## Bugs fixed while wiring this up\\n\\n- **`branch_key_suffix` \\\"Index out of bounds\\\"** — destructuring `name.split(\\\"/\\\", 2)` crashed on plain branch names without a `/` (e.g. `master`). Guarded on size. This was the root cause of `Failed to sync repository: Index out of bounds`.\\n- **`next_patch_version` `ColumnTypeMismatchError`** — `COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0)` returns the column's `Int32` type but was read `as: Int64`. Cast the aggregate to `bigint`. This was the root cause of `Failed to sync repository: ... returned a Int32 but a Int64 was expected`.\\n- **Duplicate detection missed `409`** — `find_by_owner_and_project_clone_name` compared the raw clone name against the slugified stored `project_id`, so `Hello-World` never matched `hello-world`. Now compares both raw and normalized forms.\\n- **Default branch mismatch** — imported repos using `master` were stored with `default_branch=main`, causing a spurious MR for the trunk. `adopt_mirror_default_branch!` reads the mirror HEAD and adopts the real trunk.\\n- **Status `404` returned Kemal's HTML page** — a handler that leaves the status at `404` triggers Kemal's auto-registered `error 404` handler (which renders HTML and discards the body). The status endpoint now closes the response so the JSON body is preserved.\\n\\n## Reproduction (manual E2E against the docker stack)\\n\\n```bash\\n# import\\ncurl -X POST :3001/import/github -d '{\\\"owner\\\":\\\"octocat\\\",\\\"repo\\\":\\\"Hello-World\\\",\\\"visibility\\\":\\\"public\\\"}'\\n# → 200 {\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"repository\\\":\\\"/repositories/hello-world-octocath\\\", ...}\\n\\n# duplicate (any casing) → 409\\ncurl -X POST :3001/import/github -d '{\\\"owner\\\":\\\"OCTOCAT\\\",\\\"repo\\\":\\\"hello-world\\\"}'\\n\\n# status → 200 with 3 branches / 2 merge requests\\ncurl :3001/import/github/octocat/Hello-World/status\\n\\n# unknown repo → JSON 404\\ncurl :3001/import/github/no/such/status\\n```\\n\\nVerified end-to-end: import returns `200`, the persisted record has `default_branch=master`, status reports `branchCount=3` / `mergeRequestCount=2`.\\n\\n## Automated tests\\n\\n`crater/spec/github_import_spec.cr` (5 examples, all passing):\\n- non-main trunk (`master`) — regression test for the spurious-MR bug.\\n- `detect_mirror_default_branch` detects `main` for a main-trunk mirror.\\n- `detect_mirror_default_branch` returns `nil` when HEAD cannot be resolved.\\n\\nFull crater spec suite: `27 examples, 0 failures, 0 errors`.\\n\\nCloses #172\\nEOF\\ngh pr edit 173 --title \\\"GitHub Import → Local Repository → ForgeFed (crater)\\\" [2026-06-11T12:13:26.100Z] [INFO]   ✅ Found pull request #173: "GitHub Import → Local Repository → ForgeFed (crater)"
[2026-06-11T12:13:26.536Z] [STDOUT] ## Summary

Implements **GitHub Import → Local Repository → ForgeFed** (issue #172).

Adds two endpoints to crater (lepos):

### `POST /import/github`
Body: `{"owner": "...", "repo": "...", "visibility": "public"}` (`visibility` optional, defaults to `public`).

1. Validates the body (`owner`/`repo` required).
2. Builds the remote URL `https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}.git`.
3. `RepositoryStore.ensure_ad_hoc_for_owner_and_clone_name` — creates the DB record + empty bare repo (now honouring `visibility`).
4. `RepositoryStore.git_clone_mirror!` — mirror-clones the remote, replacing the bare repo.
5. `RepositoryStore.adopt_mirror_default_branch!` — adopts the mirror's real trunk (e.g. `master`) as the default branch.
6. `ForgeFedStore.ensure_repository_resources` + `sync_repository` — federates the branches / merge requests.

Response:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "repository": "/repositories/{slug}",
  "forgeFedActor": "/repositories/{slug}",
  "cloneUrl": "/@{owner}/{repo}.git"
}
```

### `GET /import/github/:owner/:repo/status`
Returns `{ ok, slug, ownerHandle, visibility, branchCount, mergeRequestCount, createdAt }`, or a JSON `404` when the repository has not been imported.

## Error matrix

| Case | Status |
|------|--------|
| missing body / missing `owner`/`repo` | `400` |
| repository already imported | `409` |
| clone failed (e.g. repo does not exist) | `502` |
| ForgeFed sync failed | `500` |
| success | `200` |

## Bugs fixed while wiring this up

- **`branch_key_suffix` "Index out of bounds"** — destructuring `name.split("/", 2)` crashed on plain branch names without a `/` (e.g. `master`). Guarded on size. This was the root cause of `Failed to sync repository: Index out of bounds`.
- **`next_patch_version` `ColumnTypeMismatchError`** — `COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0)` returns the column's `Int32` type but was read `as: Int64`. Cast the aggregate to `bigint`. This was the root cause of `Failed to sync repository: ... returned a Int32 but a Int64 was expected`.
- **Duplicate detection missed `409`** — `find_by_owner_and_project_clone_name` compared the raw clone name against the slugified stored `project_id`, so `Hello-World` never matched `hello-world`. Now compares both raw and normalized forms.
- **Default branch mismatch** — imported repos using `master` were stored with `default_branch=main`, causing a spurious MR for the trunk. `adopt_mirror_default_branch!` reads the mirror HEAD and adopts the real trunk.
- **Status `404` returned Kemal's HTML page** — a handler that leaves the status at `404` triggers Kemal's auto-registered `error 404` handler (which renders HTML and discards the body). The status endpoint now closes the response so the JSON body is preserved.

## Reproduction (manual E2E against the docker stack)

```bash
# import
curl -X POST :3001/import/github -d '{"owner":"octocat","repo":"Hello-World","visibility":"public"}'
# → 200 {"ok":true,"repository":"/repositories/hello-world-octocath", ...}

# duplicate (any casing) → 409
curl -X POST :3001/import/github -d '{"owner":"OCTOCAT","repo":"hello-world"}'

# status → 200 with 3 branches / 2 merge requests
curl :3001/import/github/octocat/Hello-World/status

# unknown repo → JSON 404
curl :3001/import/github/no/such/status
```

Verified end-to-end: import returns `200`, the persisted record has `default_branch=master`, status reports `branchCount=3` / `mergeRequestCount=2`.

## Automated tests

`crater/spec/github_import_spec.cr` (5 examples, all passing):
- `git_clone_mirror!` mirrors a remote into the bare repo path (branches, hooks).
- `git_clone_mirror!` replaces existing bare repo contents on re-clone.
- `detect_mirror_default_branch` detects a non-main trunk (`master`) — regression test for the spurious-MR bug.
- `detect_mirror_default_branch` detects `main` for a main-trunk mirror.
- `detect_mirror_default_branch` returns `nil` when HEAD cannot be resolved.

Full crater spec suite: `27 examples, 0 failures, 0 errors`.
